messages:
maria_support: Hey y'all — ACME (org: acme-inc) opened a ticket: their monthly credits dropped to 0 about 2 hours before their expected reset window. They're on a longrunning websocket stream that started before midnight UTC and never reconnected.
ryan_sre: Do we have the tenant's timezone?
acme_cse: Customer says their billing timezone is America/Los_Angeles. Reset should be 2026-03-01 00:00 PST (UTC-8). They saw zero at 23:15 PST.
billing-bot: Refill window (per tenant config): 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z -> applies to org acme-inc. Next refill: 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z
maria_support: Hmm billing-bot shows 08:00Z which is midnight PST. So refill scheduled at expected time. Customer observed zero ~45 minutes earlier.
ryan_sre: Common pattern: longheld connections keep edge cache sticky for token checks. If the stream kept a stale token state, API edge might still return 429 until client re-auths or reconnects. Any 429s in the logs?
infra-ops: I pulled the edge logs for connection id conn-9f3a. We have repeated responses: 
```
{"ts":"2026-02-28T23:10:21Z","conn":"conn-9f3a","tenant":"acme-inc","quota_remaining":0,"status":429}
{"ts":"2026-02-28T23:11:05Z","conn":"conn-9f3a","tenant":"acme-inc","quota_remaining":0,"status":429}
{"ts":"2026-03-01T08:00:03Z","conn":"conn-9f3a","tenant":"acme-inc","quota_remaining":12000,"status":200}
```
acme_cse: That log looks like after refill we had a 200 and quota filled. But customer still saw 429s until they forced reconnect at 08:05 local.
maria_support: So behavior: refill executed server-side, but client continued using the existing connection which the edge considered quota_exhausted until reconnection.
ryan_sre: Possible causes: edge-cache TTL (token->quota mapping) not invalidated on refill; keepalive pinning; or client keeps sending the same auth token and our edge socket route didn't re-evaluate limits immediately.
infra-ops: Quick mitigation: advise customer to reconnect after refill. Longer term: we should invalidate per-connection quota caches on tenant refill event or send a control frame to workers to refresh state.
billing-bot: Note: this tenant had a burst window configured (burst_policy: allowed, burst_tokens: 5000). Burst was consumed earlier in the evening then monthly bucket drained.
maria_support: Repro steps for support guide: 1) Start longrunning stream pre-reset. 2) Exhaust tenant bucket via test calls. 3) Wait for refill timestamp server-side (check /billing/refill event). 4) Observe that existing stream continues to get 429s until reconnect.
acme_cse: Customer is asking for a rollback or manual credit grant while we fix — can support add a temporary top-up?
billing-bot: Manual top-ups require billing team approval; small emergency credit grants can be done via /admin/credits/topup with audit. Please file a billing request ticket.
maria_support: Filed billing ticket #BILL-9921 and gave customer the workaround (reconnect). Customer onboarded a client change to reconnect on 200 after refill too.
ryan_sre: Action items: (1) infra to evaluate invalidation on refill event (2) engineering to add control-plane hook for edge workers (3) docs: add note about longstreams and reconnect on refill.
infra-ops: I'll open infra issue INFRA-1287 with logs and suggested TTL changes.
maria_support: Thanks — marking this thread resolved for support side. Customer will confirm after tomorrow's reset. :thumbsup:
